title: Run HO19 / Renew Run man running

location.series: Annie Nguyen / Nike Run Core Holiday 2019

slide_intent: Let a familiar symbol connect imagery as well as sign the message so recognition operates at more than one scale.
strategic_value: The large outline Swoosh can connect athlete and product while a smaller solid Swoosh gives the text a clear Nike signature.
demonstration: A male runner against a gray wall and a larger shoe inset share a white outline Swoosh; the left column contains the Renew Run name, supporting sentence and small solid mark.
practical_value: Compare the separate jobs of an oversized graphic mark and a small identifying signature.

content_islands.name: Product copy
content_islands.spec: Place the Renew Run name, supporting sentence and solid Swoosh low in the white left column.

content_islands.name: Athlete and footwear
content_islands.spec: Overlap the runner image with a larger footwear crop at upper right.

content_islands.name: Connecting mark
content_islands.spec: Span both photographs with a thin white outline Swoosh while leaving faces and footwear readable.

reference_purposes.Expression: A male runner against a gray wall and a larger shoe inset share a white outline Swoosh; the left column contains the Renew Run name, supporting sentence and small solid mark.

ingredient.name: Outline and solid Swoosh
ingredient.role: Connect the two photographs and separately identify the message.
ingredient.application: This example stretches a white outline Swoosh across imagery and keeps a small solid black Swoosh beside the text.
ingredient.scope: Observed Nike Run Core Holiday 2019 execution, not a master logo-usage permission or spacing rule.
